title: Lamb Tagine with Indian Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired lamb tagine made with smoky spices and tender lamb.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Reduce heat to medium and sauté the onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, paprika, cumin, coriander, and salt to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tagine spice blend to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb back to the pot and add enough water to cover the meat.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the lamb in the preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 2-3 hours, or until tender.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve.
